name_zh: 哈代-拉马努金渐近公式
literal_source_claim: An asymptotic formula for the integer partition function.
canonical_claim: Let p(n) be the number of unordered partitions of n into positive integers. As n tends to infinity through the natural numbers, p(n) is asymptotic to exp(pi * sqrt(2*n/3)) / (4*n*sqrt(3)).
domain_and_universes: n ranges over Nat along Filter.atTop; p(n) is the finite cardinality of Nat.Partition n, coerced to Real; the comparison function is Real-valued.
conclusion: Real-valued asymptotic equivalence of the ordinary partition count and exp(pi * sqrt(2*n/3)) / (4*n*sqrt(3)).
excluded_degenerate_cases: No restriction at n = 0 is needed for an atTop statement, but the exact total comparison function and any eventually-positive restriction must be fixed and mutation-tested at statement phase.
